rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken expression for raising your shoulders to show uncertainty or lack of concern.

example.english: I ask them why they are late, and they just shrug.
example.traditional: 我問佢哋點解遲到，佢哋淨係聳吓膊頭。
example.jyutping: ngo5 man6 keoi5 dei6 dim2 gaai2 ci4 dou3 keoi5 dei6 zing6 hai6 sung2 haa2 bok3 tau4
